question: In which year did Kathak dancer and guru from Ujjain, Puru Dadheech receive the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his overall contribution to the performing arts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2018**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Puru Dadheech**, a renowned Kathak dancer and guru from Ujjain, was honored with the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in 2018 for his exceptional contributions to the performing arts.
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, instituted by India’s National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama, is the highest recognition given to performing artists in India.
 
• Puru Dadheech’s contributions include scripting the **first-ever Kathak syllabus for universities in India**, which has helped institutionalize the academic study of Kathak.
 
• He is celebrated for his efforts in preserving and reviving Kathak as a classical dance form while maintaining its traditional essence and cultural heritage.
 
• Through his pioneering work, he has inspired generations of dancers and contributed significantly to the global recognition of Kathak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Kathak Dance:**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight classical dance forms of India and originated in North India.
 
• It is known for its intricate footwork, graceful movements, hand gestures, and facial expressions, which are used to narrate mythological and spiritual stories.
 
• The dance form is influenced by both Hindu and Mughal traditions, showcasing a unique blend of cultural elements.
 
• Signature characteristics of Kathak include rhythmic patterns, storytelling, and elegant spins.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi:**
 
 
• Established in 1952, it is India’s national-level institution dedicated to promoting and preserving the performing arts.
 
• The Akademi confers awards annually to artists who have made exceptional contributions to music, dance, and drama.
 
• The awards aim to honor artists and encourage the continuation of India’s rich cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Other Dance Forms Recognized by Sangeet Natak Akademi:**
 
 
• India has eight classical dance forms, including Bharatnatyam, Odissi, Kathakali, Manipuri, Kuchipudi, Mohiniyattam, Sattriya, and Kathak.
 
• These dance forms have received national and international recognition for their cultural and artistic significance.
 
• Efforts like Puru Dadheech’s help preserve these art forms and promote them globally.
